query: SELECT ar.cliente, cp.centro_custos, so.estadoConfiguravel, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM cobranca_planilha cp INNER JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON cp.ar_id = ar.id INNER JOIN sales_orders so ON ar.cliente = so.cliente WHERE cp.ativo = 1 AND cp.centro_custos IS NOT NULL AND so.estadoConfiguravel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ar.cliente, cp.centro_custos, so.estadoConfiguravel HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ar.cliente LIMIT 20
